summary: One review pass completed across all 11 model views against the approved target. Major anatomy, face, dorsal-shield, and claw mismatches remain. The supplied deterministic report records 10 blockers and 1 warning. No files were modified; approval remains with the user.

findings.message: Supplied technical report: both upper arms penetrate the torso by 1.45 studs, exceeding the 0.65 maximum. Arm close-ups show crowded, overlapping attachment volumes.
findings.recommendation: Move and reshape both upper arms to preserve shoulder attachment while clearing the torso.

findings.message: Supplied technical report: left front claws 1, 2, and 3 and right front claws 1, 2, and 3 each have direction dot -0.98. Both rear claws have dot -0.95. All eight claws fail their required direction checks.
findings.recommendation: Correct each claw's orientation individually: six front claws forward and two rear claws backward.

findings.message: Front claw tips read as blunt wedge caps rather than tapered talons. Rear-claw regions appear as small projecting or partly buried wedges near the ankle volumes. Cropping and the review panel prevent complete visual verification of every tip.
findings.recommendation: Create exposed, pointed talons with coherent toe attachments and provide unobstructed views of all eight claws.

findings.message: The model's smooth, segmented limbs, rectangular chest, domed crown, broad oval muzzle, and stacked oval jaw do not match the target's integrated muscular anatomy and angular armored reptilian face. The eye bar appears approximately symmetric, but coherent crown, vent, muzzle, and jaw orientation cannot be fully verified.
findings.recommendation: Rebuild the primary anatomical forms and facial planes around the approved target's proportions and armored construction.

findings.message: The dorsal forms read as simple triangular fins or spikes instead of broad, irregular shattered storm shields. Seven distinct qualifying shields cannot be verified, and the target's fractured surfaces and yellow fissures are not established.
findings.recommendation: Form seven distinct, broad angular shields with broken contours, fractured faces, and restrained yellow fissures.

findings.message: Legs are bulkier than the arms, but stacked rounded segments and visible ankle-to-toe gaps undermine continuous, load-bearing digitigrade anatomy.
findings.recommendation: Integrate thighs, knees, raised hocks, and feet into a continuous weight-bearing structure.

findings.message: Supplied technical report: height/depth ratio is 1.153, below the 1.35 threshold. Visually, the torso is upright and the arms do not support the body.
findings.recommendation: Reconcile the ratio warning with the long tail's contribution to overall depth.

criteria.reason: Anatomy, facial construction, proportions, surface treatment, and dorsal silhouette differ substantially from the approved target.
Approximate eye symmetry is visible, but the crown, muzzle, and jaw form stacked primitives; vents and complete facial orientation cannot be verified from the obstructed close-ups.
Both arm close-ups show crowded intersections, and the supplied deterministic report confirms excessive penetration on both sides.
All six front claws and both rear claws fail supplied direction checks; visible tips also read as blunt caps or partly buried wedges.
Front and side views show an upright torso carried by the legs, with arms hanging clear of the ground. The separate ratio warning remains.
A biped, dorsal ridge, and tail are present, but the rounded segmented body and simple fins do not preserve the target's defining armored chimera silhouette.
Dorsal forms read as simple spikes or fins; seven distinct shattered shield forms cannot be verified.
Leg mass exceeds arm mass, but disconnected-looking feet and rounded limb segments do not convincingly establish load-bearing digitigrade anatomy.
